premises.text: Large organizations rely on more contractors/vendors than full-time employees
premises.evidence_span: They all have twice as many contractors and vendors doing work for them than they have full-time employees

premises.text: Finding contractors via shout-outs, email, and spreadsheets wastes time
premises.evidence_span: I would literally shout across a room, send emails around looking for recommendations, or resort to the outdated spreadsheets

premises.text: Cross-company engagement is fragmented across chat channels and document apps
premises.evidence_span: multiple team members, multiple departments, chatting through tons of different channels, and tons of different document sharing apps

premises.text: Searchable contractor cards make contributor networks accessible company-wide
premises.evidence_span: she's imported those old spreadsheets, and we've built these contractor cards of everyone. And now they're searchable and accessible by everyone

premises.text: Flexible onboarding templates capture rates, availability, and terms via shareable forms
premises.evidence_span: she can create these super flexible onboarding templates

premises.text: Profiles track skills, availability, and internal feedback as retained institutional knowledge
premises.evidence_span: she can track everything she needs to know about him, from his availability, the original onboarding information, the skills he possesses, and more importantly, the internal feedback

premises.text: Dual private/shared project workspace with email-integrated communication thread
premises.evidence_span: it will create this dual project tracking interface, with one tab private only to the economist

premises.text: Auto-request feedback and invoices; approve and pay contributors across many countries
premises.evidence_span: we will auto-request feedback from all the team members that have worked with Patrick

premises.text: SaaS freemium lets companies use the product for free
premises.evidence_span: we're a SaaS company with a freemium model

value.text: Companies can onboard, manage, communicate with, and pay large contributor networks in one place
value.evidence_span: how we're helping companies like Google, like The Economist, onboard, manage, communicate with, and pay these huge contributor networks

causal_links.evidence_span: this whole workflow process between companies to outsource parties is a complete mess
All of their contributor network information, past and future, will be stored in one place
she can approve the payments and distribute them to up to 80 countries all through Listable
